response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with strong web, backend, and tooling skills, but the profile does not match this embedded networking security role. The position has hard requirements — native-level Japanese, strong C for UNIX development, and hands-on Linux kernel analysis/modification — none of which are evidenced. C/C++ work is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, and there is no experience with LAN switches, MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 networking, SNMP/NETCONF, or chip-vendor SDKs. Language list shows English, Romanian, and basic German only, which alone disqualifies against the native Japanese requirement.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering across many stacks
Some low-level/systems exposure (C/C++ at NI, C++ audio thesis, high-performance D services)
Strong testing/TDD, CI/CD, and DevOps discipline plus community teaching
concerns: No Japanese proficiency stated; native-level is a hard requirement
Minimal recent C and no Linux kernel source-level experience
No networking, switch, or embedded security domain experience

key_factors.factor: Lack of embedded/network security and switch domain experience
Weak recent C / Linux kernel depth
